mapper.insert:
insert into RENT_CTRT ( /* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.rentCtrt.mapper.IRentCtrtMapper.insertRentCtrt */ RENT_CTRT_NO , USER_NO , REG_DT , CTRT_STTS_CD , RENT_LSTG_NO , DPST_AMT , MTHLY_RENT_AMT , SBMSN_DOC_NO , MVIN_DT )
select #{map.rentCtrtNo} , A.USER_NO , sysdate , 'PENDING' , R.RENT_LSTG_NO , R.DPST_AMT , R.MTHLY_RENT_AMT , DOC.SBMSN_DOC_NO , ANN.MVIN_PRD_DT from APLCT A inner join APT_HO_TY HT on(A.HO_TY_NO = HT.HO_TY_NO) inner join APT_DETAIL H on(HT.HO_TY_NO = H.HO_TY_NO) inner join RENT_LISTING R on(H.HO_NO = R.HO_NO) inner join SBMSN_DOC DOC on(DOC.APLCT_NO = A.APLCT_NO) inner join CENTER_ANN_BOARD_POST ANN on(A.ANN_NO = ANN.ANN_NO) where A.APLCT_NO = #{map.aplctNo} and ROWNUM = 1
mapper.select: select /* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.rentCtrt.mapper.IRentCtrtMapper.selectCtrt */ C.RENT_CTRT_NO , U.USER_ID , C.USER_NO , U.USER_NM , A.APT_CMPLEX_NO , A.APT_CMPLEX_NM , C.CTRT_APRV_DT , C.MVIN_DT , C.MVOUT_DT , C.DPST_AMT , C.MTHLY_RENT_AMT , C.CTRT_STTS_CD , M.USER_NO as CTRT_MGR_USER_NO from RENT_CTRT C inner join CTRT_MGR M on(C.RENT_CTRT_NO = M.RENT_CTRT_NO) inner join RENT_LISTING L on(C.RENT_LSTG_NO = L.RENT_LSTG_NO) inner join APT_DETAIL H on(H.HO_NO = L.HO_NO) inner join APT_UNIT D on(D.DONG_NO = H.DONG_NO) inner join APT_COMPLEX A on(A.APT_CMPLEX_NO = D.APT_CMPLEX_NO) inner join MEMBER U on(C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO) where M.USER_NO = #{userNo} and M.CHG_YN = 'N'
select COUNT(*) /* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.rentCtrt.mapper.IRentCtrtMapper.selectCtrtCount */ from RENT_CTRT C inner join CTRT_MGR M on(C.RENT_CTRT_NO = M.RENT_CTRT_NO) where M.USER_NO = #{userNo}
